description: Export this site's DocType metadata as an NVIDIA Auto Ontology model.

fields.description: One module per line. Child tables of included DocTypes are added automatically.
fields.label: Modules

fields.description: Extra DocTypes to include, one per line, e.g. Employee (excluded by default because it holds personal data).
fields.label: Also Include DocTypes

fields.default: ( Log| Settings| Tool)$|^(Employee|Repost |Process |Transaction Deletion|Bisect |Ledger Health|Ledger Merge|Bank Statement Import|Email Digest)
fields.description: DocTypes whose name matches this regular expression are left out. Clear it to keep everything.
fields.label: Exclude DocTypes Matching

fields.description: Also include tables that the chosen DocTypes link to, such as Currency, UOM and Territory.
fields.label: Include Linked Tables

fields.description: Add the built-in ERPNext measures (net sales, receivables, GL balance, stock on hand...). Review them before certifying in Auto Ontology.
fields.label: Include Business Measures

fields.description: Web app address, e.g. https://ontology.example.com (port 3000 on a default install).
fields.label: Auto Ontology URL

fields.description: Create one in Auto Ontology under your user menu, API Tokens. The user needs the model import permission.
fields.label: API Token

fields.description: When on, Auto Ontology deletes terms and measures for this database that are not in the uploaded model. Leave off unless you mean to replace edits made in Auto Ontology.
fields.label: Replace Existing Definitions

name: Ontology Export Settings
